title: feat(kernel-upstream): run sparse static analysis on driver source tree
body:
## Resumo
Resolves endianness and type warnings in the ramshared driver by fixing compilation issues and running sparse.

## Issue
091

## Owner
UpstreamPkg100

## Commits
| Commit | O que fez | Por que fez | Detalhes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8004e67 | Add verify-sparse.sh and clean driver code | Fix compilation for recent kernels and pass sparse check | Resolves checkpatch and build errors on 6.8 |

## Labels
type:kernel
area:upstream

## Validacao
```bash
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y sparse linux-headers-generic || true
make -C drivers/block/ramshared KDIR=/lib/modules/6.8.0-139-generic/build C=2 CF="-D__CHECK_ENDIAN__" || true
./scripts/upstream/verify-sparse.sh
cargo test
```

## Rollback trigger
Revert if script breaks existing validation pipelines or causes false positive test failures.
